eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Walk-in primary care open across Delhi (NCT); non-NCT NCR residents use home state for domicile-linked schemes/referrals.
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Open to all citizens visiting centres.

benefit.summary_hi: दिल्ली के मोहल्ला/आरोग्य केंद्रों पर निःशुल्क प्राथमिक डॉक्टर परामर्श, आवश्यक दवाएं, मातृ-शिशु देखभाल और लैब जांच।
benefit.summary_en: Free primary OPD consultations, essential medicines, maternal/child care, NCD screening & diagnostics at neighbourhood centres across Delhi.

benefit_summary.en: Free primary OPD consultations, essential medicines, maternal/child care, NCD screening & diagnostics at neighbourhood centres across Delhi.
benefit_summary.hi: दिल्ली के मोहल्ला/आरोग्य केंद्रों पर निःशुल्क प्राथमिक डॉक्टर परामर्श, आवश्यक दवाएं, मातृ-शिशु देखभाल और लैब जांच।

application_steps.online: Create optional ABHA ID on abha.abdm.gov.in.
application_steps.offline: Walk in directly to nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir Delhi.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
